messages:
avery: pushed fw v1.2.4 to apac1 racks ~20m ago. now seeing serial consoles stuck at tty0 during early boot, provisioner reporting 'tty0 hung' and multiple GPUs being evicted. anyone oncall seeing this?
jun: yep, apac1-gpu-6..10 failing provisioning, jobs preempting. link to logs: http://internal/logs/apac1/1738500000 :thinking:
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-APAC-2025-078 — serial console hang / provisioning failures (assigned: oncall)
oscar: any common SKU / BMC batch? did the secureboot/uefi lockdown flip in this build?
avery: fw release notes mention 'enable uefi lockdown for sku-b4' — rolling it back on rack-7 to test. can someone capture serial output during reboot?
marie: starting capture on rack-7 serial now. command: ```ssh jumphost && sudo serialctl -r /dev/ttyUSB0 -b 115200 --capture /tmp/boot-rack7.log```
marie: pasted log snippet: "efi: EFI v2.70 by vendor
efi_lockdown: enabled
console: tty0 hung after 42s
kernel: kexec: attempted on incorrect image"
kai: heads-up — losing these GPU nodes is already causing autoscaler to overshoot and batch jobs to requeue, hitting cost SLOs. we should throttle rollouts and add routing fallback to eu-west until apac stabilizes.
jun: can we pin inference routing away from apac1 for burst traffic? also temporarily reduce batch size to lower memory pressure. cc @product for routing change permission.
avery: rollback started on apac1-rack-7 (manual flash to v1.2.3). deploy-bot: "rollback initiated by avery for apac1-rack-7"
deploy-bot: rollback job 892314 queued -> started
oscar: note — disabling console multiplexing on BMC will avoid tty reassignments but reduces debug visibility. prefer keeping serial but ensure FW keeps /dev/tty0 mapping stable.
marie: rack-7 back up, provisioning passed, serial prints resumed. rack-2 and rack-9 still degrade (showing efi_lockdown toggles).
kai: cost mitigation: lowered autoscale min from 30->18 for apac1, added temporary budget alert. runbook snippet to revert: ```gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize --size 18 ig-apac1-gpu-pool```
avery: next steps: pause v1.2.4 rollout for apac, add canary check to ensure tty0 prints kernel banner within 15s, add automatic fallback to previous image on tty hang, and open RFC for safer UEFI lockdown gating. will follow up with changelog and postmortem once stable. :thumbsup:
jun: thanks — I'll update incident and coordinate routing change.
marie: attaching full capture to INC-APAC-2025-078 for postmortem.
kai: also adding a short-term eval to Redwood Optimize to suggest reducing batch size when node count drops below threshold (to avoid cost spike).
avery: fine-grained rollout policy will be updated — holding all other regions.
marie: closing capture, monitoring for 30m.
